industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers
name: Jiangsu New Energy Development Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu New Energy Development Co., Ltd. focuses on the entire lifecycle of sustainable power generation, from funding and building to the ongoing management of wind, solar, and biomass energy plants. In addition to its energy projects, the firm also engineers and fabricates specialized industrial equipment, including marine wind power generators. Founded in 2002, this Nanjing, China-based enterprise operates as a division of Jiangsu Guoxin Investment Group Limited.
